title: Coins and notes
examples: What is a pound coin worth?
Can I make fifty pence with coins?
If I have two pounds, what coins can I use?

explain.say: Today we are learning about money coins and notes.
Look at these coins. Some are for one penny, and some are for two pence.
A ten pence coin is worth ten small coins. It is a good amount.
We can make amounts using different coins. For example, we can make twenty pence.
Let us make seventy-five pence. We can use three coins and some notes.

items: Start with a one pound note
You are left with seventy-five pence

explain.say: When you buy a sweet, you might pay with a one pound coin. The shop gives you change.

faq.q: Can I use coins and notes together to pay?
faq.a: Yes, you can use both coins and notes to pay for things. You can use a pound note and some coins.
asks: Can I mix coins and notes?
Is it okay to use both?

faq.q: What is the difference between pence and pounds?
faq.a: A pound is a bigger unit of money than pence. There are one hundred pence in one pound.
asks: How many pence in a pound?

faq.q: How do I make a specific amount like fifty pence?
faq.a: You can use different combinations of coins to make that amount. For example, two 20p coins make fifty pence.

faq.q: If I pay with a ten pound note, what happens?
faq.a: The shop will give you change back. The change will be the amount you need minus ten pounds.

faq.q: Are all coins the same colour?
faq.a: No, the coins have different colours and pictures. The colours help us see the value quickly.
asks: How do I know the value?

facts: One pound is equal to one hundred pence.
Coins have values like one penny, two pence, five pence, and ten pence.
Notes are used for larger amounts of money.
Making change means getting back the correct amount.

quiz.say: Which combination correctly makes thirty pence?
quiz.show: 30p: (a) Three 10p coins (b) Six 5p coins (c) Three 5p coins
quiz.why: Three 10p coins add up to thirty pence, which is the correct total.

wrong.0: This only makes fifteen pence, which is too little for thirty pence.
wrong.1: This only makes three pence, which is much less than thirty pence.
wrong.3: This equals thirty pence, but three 10p coins is a simpler way to show it.

quiz.say: If you need to make eighty pence, which is a good combination?
quiz.show: 80p: (a) Eight 10p coins (b) One 50p coin and three 10p coins (c) Sixteen 5p coins
quiz.why: Fifty pence plus thirty pence equals eighty pence, making it a good mix.

wrong.0: This only makes seventy pence, which is ten pence too little.
wrong.2: This only makes eighty pence, but option (b) shows using different types of coins.
wrong.3: Sixteen times five pence is eighty pence, but option (b) is a more varied combination.

quiz.say: Which coins would you use to pay for something costing one pound and twenty pence?
quiz.show: £1.20: (a) One pound coin and two 10p coins (b) Two 50p coins and two 10p coins (c) One pound note and two 1p coins

options.show: (d) One pound coin and one 10p coin
options.say: (d) One pound coin and one 10p coin

options.show: (a) One pound coin and two 10p coins
options.say: (a) One pound coin and two 10p coins

options.show: (c) One pound note and two 1p coins
options.say: (c) One pound note and two 1p coins

quiz.why: One pound plus twenty pence equals one pound and twenty pence, which is correct.

wrong.0: This only equals one pound and ten pence, which is ten pence too little.
wrong.2: This equals one pound and twenty pence, but using a pound coin is the most direct way.
wrong.3: This only equals one pound and two pence, missing the remaining twenty pence.
